design: research/tail_screening/agent_pilot.md; saved grouped rankings, no new inference
variant_task: Financial-context textual sentiment toward the designated entity; absence of direction is neutral, not automatically unrankable
development_status: Both variants use the same 128-item development sample. V2 is a revised measurement task after V1 inspection, not a new validation set.

full_population_gate.explanation: All original IDs are rankable. The working gate uses the full 128-item development population and all specified same-model directions/tails at 10% and 20%; this is not an independently validated statistical test.

complete_case_diagnostic.population: All 128 original development items are rankable; common subset equals original finite population
complete_case_diagnostic.rank_recalculation: Filter each ordered group to the common subset, drop empty groups, then recompute within-subset midranks

metric_definitions.reference_and_proxy: A defines target tail, B is the screening ordering; Sol is a reference, not truth
metric_definitions.nominal_tail: floor(n*p); include every member of the boundary tie group
metric_definitions.q90: Highest B threshold recovering ceil(0.9*A_actual_tail_n), retaining its entire boundary tie group
metric_definitions.widening: q90 / nominal p, not divided by tie-expanded A fraction
metric_definitions.same_budget: Both cutoffs use the same nominal floor(n*p), then retain their respective complete boundary groups; actual admitted counts can differ
metric_definitions.same_budget_recall: Intersection size / actual A tail size; overlap/nominal is also shown and can exceed one due to ties
metric_definitions.boundary_expansion: A and same-budget B: actual count minus nominal count. q90 B has no independent nominal budget, so report its cutoff tie size, strict count, and tie size minus one explicitly
metric_definitions.correlations: Midrank Spearman; normal-score rho uses Phi^-1((average_rank-.5)/n) on the common subset
metric_definitions.Gaussian: Optional symmetric Gaussian-copula numerical comparator using normal-score rho; no test or assertion that its model fits grouped rankings
metric_definitions.sensitivity_range: Minimum/maximum across four cross-model combinations; not a confidence interval or independent replication
metric_definitions.small_tail: 5% is exploratory and tiny; formal working thresholds were specified for 10% and 20% only
